user.title: ATX LED Hub
user.description: Enter the local hub address. Setup discovers already commissioned lights, groups, and scenes and does not turn them on, identify them, or change DALI addresses.

data_description.host: IP address or hostname of the hub
data_description.username: Only needed if the hub API requires authentication
data_description.password: Only needed if the hub API requires authentication

reconfigure.title: Reconfigure ATX LED Hub
reconfigure.description: Update the hub address. Existing light and scene entities are kept.

error.cannot_connect: Cannot connect to the ATX LED hub
error.invalid_response: The hub returned an unexpected response

init.title: Unsigned leftover drivers
init.description: Pick a driver the hub could not characterize. Home Assistant stores mode and ranges locally and does not write them to the hub.

tune.title: Tune leftover driver
tune.description: Match min/max dim and Kelvin by sight. Min dim is Home Assistant 1%. RGB mode is stored but color picker waits until the hub RGB write is verified.

error.invalid_range: Min dim must be below max dim, each between 1 and 254
error.invalid_kelvin: Warm Kelvin must be below cool Kelvin

abort.no_unsigned: This hub has no unsigned leftover drivers to tune
